# Use a standard Ubuntu base image suitable for CPU-based HPC workloads.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set this environment variable to prevent interactive prompts during package installation.
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, Git, OpenMPI, and certificates.
# OpenMPI is the MPI implementation used for this build.
# We clean up the apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# These settings help prevent common errors related to process binding,
# network interface selection (disabling InfiniBand which is not present),
# and shared memory mechanisms within containers.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=ssh
ENV OMPI_MCA_orte_default_hostfile=/dev/null
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_hwloc_base_binding_policy=none

# Set a working directory for the build process.
WORKDIR /build

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 (LLNL AMG) repository.
# CORRECTION: Run 'make' from the repository root to build all required library
# dependencies before building the final test executable.
# Then, copy the executable from its location in 'test/' to a system-wide PATH,
# and clean up the source code to keep the final image lean.
RUN git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg.git && \
    cd amg && \
    make && \
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /build/amg

# Reset the working directory to a neutral location.
WORKDIR /

# Provide a default command. Running the application with '-h' will display its help/usage info.
CMD ["amg", "-h"]

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg-minicluster-aws-cpu
  # The Kubernetes namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. This should match the number of processes requested by the application.
  tasks: 4

  # When set to false, the pods and services are not deleted after the job completes.
  # This is useful for debugging and inspecting logs.
  cleanup: false

  # Specifies the logging verbosity and behavior for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Strict mode ensures that any logging-related errors will cause the job to fail.
    strict: true

  # Defines the container(s) that will run as part of the MiniCluster.
  # For this job, we only need one container definition.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This container is a worker, not a launcher. The Flux Operator will inject the flux broker and run the command.
      launcher: false
      # The command to execute within the container.

manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.details: Clone the latest branch of amg2023. You MUST put amg on the PATH.

context.optimize:
Maximize the amg2023 figure of merit. You MUST maximize memory per CPU core. More cores are better.
The trick to optimizing this is THREADING. You MUST force OpenMP and any math libraries to use only one thread per MPI rank. On example is setting OMP_NUM_THREADS to "1". You might also consider setting OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism to "cma" as a conservative builder will set to none.
YOU MUST SLOWLY increase the problem size, one dimension at a time, by an increment no more than double the current to increase the FOM. A timeout may not require a smaller problem size but rather a different instance.
A previous run example that has worked well:
  amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 8 4 1 on m7g.16xlarge with FOM 8.039496e+08
The size of the MiniCluster MUST be 1. Tasks MUST be at least 4.
To reduce noise in logging, you can set logging.quiet to true.
